title: China misusing Interpol to target dissidents, says leading UK lawyer
summary_full: Concerns over Beijing’s use of ‘red notices’ as Hong Kong prepares to host police organisation’s general assemblyChina is misusing Interpol to target and silence dissidents, a leading British lawyer has claimed, as Hong Kong prepares to host the police organisation’s general assembly for the first time.Ben Keith, a specialist in “red notices” - the Interpol system under which national authorities are requested to locate and detain suspects - said he was working on five cases involving China making questionable requests through Interpol.
